core_idea: Hook Office Fixer Hong Lu is a Damage Dealer — **Bleed** stacker — payoff coins check **2+ Bleed**, so build the count before committing them. Bleed ticks when the afflicted unit tosses an attack Coin.
playstyle_guide:
- Skills check **2+ Bleed** — favour those coins when stacked.
- **Haste** triggers on **Evade** — Evade when you want the Speed spike next turn.
- Hold S3 for when At 6+ Speed is met — that condition is what unlocks its full damage ceiling.

**S1 — Track** (BP 3, CP +4, 2 coins): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low / Slightly High stacked).
- Needs 2+ Haste to activate — prioritise building stacks before using.
- Inflict 1 Bleed; [Heads Hit] Inflict +1 Bleed Count

**S2 — Goin' First** (BP 4, CP +3, 3 coins): rolls — low 4, high 13 (Low / Slightly Low stacked).
- Needs 6+ Speed to activate — prioritise building stacks before using.

**S3 — Rampage** (BP 4, CP +2, 4 coins): rolls — low 4, high 12 (Extremely Low / Slightly Low stacked).
- Needs 6+ Speed to activate — prioritise building stacks before using.
- Heal 1 SP per Bleed on target (Max 5)

Combat passive — **Hook**: Upon defeating an enemy, gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn (Once per turn).

Combat passive — **Mass-produced Bionic Gear**: When 1 ally with the fastest Speed defeats an enemy that has Bleed, gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn (Once per turn).
